title: 智慧義肢手肌電控制
summary: 「智慧義肢手肌電控制」教學路線圖：裝置架構、感測與致動、台架測試和品質管理；不含臨床操作指示。專案級來源與工序細節待查證。
summaryEn: Learning roadmap for Smart Prosthetic Hand Myoelectric Control: device architecture, sensing and actuation, bench testing, and quality management; no clinical operating instructions. Project-specific sources and work steps require verification.
